query: SELECT mc.characterName, mc.imageUrl, ms.name as setName FROM marvel_cards mc JOIN marvel_sets ms ON mc.setId = ms.id WHERE (mc.characterName LIKE '%Deadpool%' OR mc.characterName LIKE '%Thing%') AND ms.name LIKE '%Comic Book%' LIMIT 5;
